description: Control your own life and stop inserting yourself into others lives #selflove #relationships #selfcare
transcript: I don't care what other people do, no one has enough access to me to disrupt my life, not easily offended, I don't take anything personal because it's not about me. I do not think about people when I'm not with them. I live in my world and that keeps me healthy. What others do is out of my control, I am not here to convince anyone of anything, I am not here to push or pull anyone's life in any other direction. You go where you feel is necessary.
